title: Storage inventory
description: What the storage says about ITSELF: which stores exist, what they are keyed by, and which secondary indexes they carry. Produced by dumping the deployed storage — never by reading application code. The sibling of the route inventory, and it exists for the same reason: a card's claim about where data lives is otherwise a claim nobody can be wrong about.

produced_by.description: How this file was made, in words a human can check. An inventory of unknown origin is worse than none: it looks like evidence.

environment.description: Which environment was dumped. Store names usually carry it as a suffix, and cards must never name one.

keyed_by.description: The primary key attributes, in order: partition key first, then sort key if there is one.
